# Holocron

> Holocron is a Go network video recorder: one executable (`holocron`) records RTSP cameras with ffmpeg, supervises its own processes, serves a web app and alerts. It replaced the PowerShell system in this repository on 2026-10-22; the PowerShell scripts remain as the legacy fallback.

Branch `portable-nvr`. Rules for agents are in AGENTS.md. Facts in the documents below carry file paths; items marked UNVERIFIED have not been run.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): hard rules for any AI agent working in this repository (never touch the live system, no credential files, commit rules, how to run tests)
- [Holocron for agents](docs/ai/holocron-for-agents.md): the full structured reference - architecture, package map, command registry, guarantees G1 to G15 and their tests, configuration, state files, access classes, per-OS process lifetime, testing, how to extend, limits, glossary
- [Quickstart](docs/holocron-quickstart.md): four steps from nothing to a recording NVR, Windows first, then Linux and macOS
- [Cheat sheet](docs/holocron-cheatsheet.md): commands by intent, files, ports, exit codes, alert ids, the ten likeliest problems, rollback in four lines

## Operating

- [Cutover](docs/cutover.md): moving the real NVR from the PowerShell system to Holocron, step by step with stop conditions
- [Rollback](docs/rollback.md): the way back, and how to rehearse it
- [Autostart](docs/autostart.md): `holocron install`, logon task, Windows service, systemd, launchd, Defender note
- [The web app](docs/ui.md): screens, Live view, HTTPS on the LAN, users, roles, the Admin tab
- [Alerts](docs/alerts.md): event ids and meanings
- [Shadow run](docs/shadow.md): running Holocron beside the old system and `archive compare`
- [Continuous integration](docs/ci.md): what runs, how to run the same locally
- [Cutover plan and record](tasks/portable-nvr/cutover-plan.md): decisions, stop rules, the 22 Oct 2026 record and its findings

## Design and decisions

- [High-level design](tasks/portable-nvr/os-independent-hld.md): rules R1 and R2, architecture, technology choices, decisions D2 to D19
- [Low-level design](tasks/portable-nvr/os-independent-lld.md): per-package plan and the work items
- [Supervisor inventory](tasks/portable-nvr/spec/inventory-supervisor.md): the guarantees G1 to G15 and the status.json fields of the system Holocron reproduces
- [Commission ledger](tasks/portable-nvr/ledger.md): every merge into `portable-nvr`
- [Configuration keys](internal/config/KEYS.md): every `holocron.config.json` key, default, rule and whether `config set` may edit it
